design.selection: all exact-DEAD frozen class-5 multi-parent cases, no fate-conditioned subset
design.hintPolicy: historical accepted hints nominate both segment revisions and completing suffix; offline evidence ONLY, strictly forbidden as runtime inputs
design.segment: same endpoint pair, same RAW path transitions (including portal edges), edited interior, unchanged >=4 raw moves at prefix and suffix
design.ranking: sha256 of complete patched-prefix geometry, outcome-blind
design.outcome: only native PLAY-referee accepted COMPLETE patched paths count as restored, not syntactic prefix or CP-SAT UNKNOWN

caveats: Historically guided repair is NOT a new cold solve; it only measures reference-guided segment-revision capability.
Move-legal revised prefixes are NOT oracle LIVE: they can still be provably DEAD under coupled obligations or exact length/intersection requirements.
A failed native complete path may still be a legitimate, completable revised prefix; no DEAD claim is made for a patch.
Raw-length-preserving substitutions do not guarantee game-counted length on portal boards; native referee decides.
